name: When should I hire a general contractor instead of individual trade contractors for one room?

mainEntity.name: When should I hire a general contractor instead of individual trade contractors for one room?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a general contractor provides a single point of accountability when a remodel involves multiple specialized trades. If your renovation only requires repainting and minor drywall patching, a single specialty tradesperson may be sufficient. However, if your room update involves custom framing, tile installation, drywall, and sub-trades like licensed electricians or plumbers, a general contractor manages the sequencing and quality control. This coordination prevents costly scheduling conflicts, such as waiting on wiring changes after drywall is already installed, and ensures finish carpentry and painting integrate smoothly with rough construction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hire a general contractor when your project combines multiple tasks like framing, electrical, drywall, and tile to ensure smooth scheduling and single-point accountability.
